name: lead-distribution-platform
description: Local development orchestration for the lead distribution platform

scripts.dev: npm run db:up && concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && npm run db:up
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix api install && npm --prefix web install
